theorem_statement: Let p=147457, d=87, and epsilon=7349491214/21743566849. Under uniform affine-line sampling followed by a uniform point on the selected line, every degree-at-most-87 line table and every point table with acceptance at least epsilon admit one polynomial in F_p[X,Y] of total degree at most 87 agreeing with the point table on more than epsilon/10 of F_p^2, hence on at least 734949122 points. Since epsilon/10>174/147457, this is the required max(2d/p,epsilon/10) recovery. The absolute score is 7349491214.
